summary: Console: Internal Unit Economics dashboard shows "Permission denied" for Finance users (RBAC/feature flag allowlist)
description:
Issue summary:
Finance users are unable to access the internal Unit Economics dashboard page in Console. They see a "Permission denied" message immediately upon navigation.

Requestor(s):
- Rishi Malhotra (FP&A)
- Laura Bennett (CFO) flagged as a broader rollout blocker if Finance cannot access.

Impact:
- Finance cannot validate / sign off on blended $/1M output tokens in the internal Console dashboard.
- Blocks dogfooding / review workflow for exec reporting.

Where:
Console -> Internal -> Unit Economics (internal-only page)

What changed recently:
- Internal dashboard gated behind feature flag + RBAC allowlist per ENG-8434.
- Recent rollout to a broader internal audience beyond Eng/Console team.

Error details:
- UI banner: "Permission denied"
- Network: GET /internal/unit-econ/* returns 403 (not 404)

Notes:
This ticket is internal-support because the immediate ask is unblocking user access; engineering work exists but the fix should be limited to RBAC/feature flag configuration and audit trail.

References:
- Slack thread: #eng 1738289001-feature-flag-and-rbac-review
- Launch checklist item: ensure Finance group included in allowlist before dogfood announcement
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Login to Console with an account in Finance (confirmed with Rishi)
2) Navigate to /console/internal/unit-economics
3) Observe "Permission denied" page
4) Open devtools -> Network -> observe 403 responses from unit econ endpoints
expected_result: Finance users in the approved internal allowlist should be able to load the Unit Economics dashboard and query aggregated views.
actual_result: Finance users receive a permission denied error and all unit econ API calls return 403.
impact: P2 internal blocker for Finance sign-off and KPI reporting readiness. No external customer impact.
root_cause:
RBAC policy for the internal unit economics dashboard required BOTH (a) feature flag enabled and (b) membership in an allowlisted role/group. Finance users were not mapped into the correct internal role ("unit-econ-dashboard-viewer") and the feature flag allowlist was limited to the initial Eng pilot groups.

Contributing factor: The allowlist used an outdated group identifier for Finance ("finance"), but Rishi/FP&A are in "finance-fpa"; CFO account is in "finance-leadership". The RBAC mapping did not include either group.
resolution:
1) Updated RBAC mapping to include Finance groups:
   - finance-fpa -> unit-econ-dashboard-viewer
   - finance-leadership -> unit-econ-dashboard-viewer
2) Updated feature flag allowlist to include the same groups.
3) Verified access with Rishi (FP&A) and confirmed the page loads + queries succeed.
4) Captured audit note for Security review (no customer data exposure; dashboard is aggregated and internal-only).

Follow-ups:
- Add a lightweight "request access" link on the permission denied page pointing to Internal Support (future UX task).
- Add a pre-launch checklist item to validate at least one Finance test account in staging before broad enablement.
